integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the published base e-BH definition and the e-value mean constraint. Numerical checks only verify arithmetic examples and finite instances; they are not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete null; iid identically distributed two-point e-values only. The finite maximization is exact for all \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), while the closed-form one-spike optimizer is proved only for \(\alpha<1/(e^2+1/2)\). No claim is made for all independent e-value laws or for non-null mixtures.
title: Sharp iid all-or-nothing e-BH calibration under the complete null
